description: SFLOW semi-implicit step with the one-step predictor (A 210 11, theta 0.5), hydrostatic: Stoker dam break on a flat frictionless bed (h_l 0.5 m, h_r 0.05 m, dam at x = 20 m, dx 0.05 m). The bore with the BCG advection and the advective limit of A 210 11 (flow Courant number at most 0.8 N 47); A 210 12/13 miss this bore by 5 - 17 %.
